headline: GIFT Nifty signals muted open for Indian markets amid Asian tech selloff and firm US dollar

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty signals a muted start for Sensex and Nifty 50.
Asian markets decline following a tech selloff.
US dollar reaches a 19-month peak on Federal Reserve rate hike bets.
Crude oil prices decline on supply surplus expectations despite Gulf tensions.
whatHappening: Asian equities trade lower as technology shares experience selling pressure.
Gold hovers near an over one-year low, weighed down by a strong dollar and Fed hike bets.
Brent crude falls to $92 per barrel amid a growing supply glut.
Berkshire reduces stakes in Bank of America and Capital One while increasing its position in Delta.
summary: Indian benchmark indices are set for a muted start according to GIFT Nifty trends. Global markets show weakness with Asian shares declining due to a tech selloff and the US dollar touching a 19-month high. Meanwhile, oil and gold prices remain under pressure.
